args: if [ -n "$CREW_STUDIO_BIN" ]; then exec "$CREW_STUDIO_BIN" mcp; elif [ -n "$CREW_STUDIO_SRC" ]; then exec bun "$CREW_STUDIO_SRC/src/mcp.ts"; elif command -v crew-studio >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec crew-studio mcp; else echo "crew-studio mcp: Studio not found: set CREW_STUDIO_BIN to the Studio binary or CREW_STUDIO_SRC to a checkout (the grant dialog Plug-in tab shows both)" >&2; exit 127; fi
